H: The savvy project manager. She gives a lot – maybe too much – and she has so many friends (of both sexes) that she hasn’t got the time to see them all. A very sexy lady.
Hadassah: Hadassah is rational, she is diplomatic, she has style and she detests grubby people. Some individuals appear as though they never need to rush anything, and this is Hadassah. By the same token, she doesn't speak without considering her words and trivial, meaningless career paths are none of her business. By default she is very well educated.
Hahmoni: One minute genius, the next minute crazy. Perhaps she hangs out with Charlie too much? Either way, Hahmoni is a delight.
Haidee: Haidee detests second place, and she's not averse to the idea of running over loved-ones or family members to get there.
Hailee:
Never one to antagonise over a decision, Hailee makes her mind up lickety-split and then bounds into action. Are her decisions ever wrong? Well, who gives a rat’s arse if they are because you never know unless you try, and if you’re optimistic then the past doesn’t bloody-well come into discussion anyway: this is Hailee’s personal motto.
And she’s very happy to kiss in public. (All the happy optimists are.) 
The End.
Hailey: As a little girl she always wanted a pony but her family could never afford one. Full of good intentions for everyone and everything, she’s a good soul and good company.
Haley: Yep, this goes for Hailey and Haily as well: As a little girl she always wanted a pony but her family could never afford one. Full of good intentions for everyone and everything, she’s a good soul and good company. And ain’t nothing wrong with that. Love Management. x
Halle: Halle lives quite simply but don't presume her possessions are meagre. Not that material wealth drives her being, but Halle takes the time to do things properly and thoroughly. Many deem her to be something of a schemer but all she's doing, ladies and gentlemen, is biding her time and keeping her thoughts to herself.
Hanley:
Did you ever watch the early James Bond movies? You did? Okay, splendid. Well did you know Moneypenny was originally called Hanley?
True story. In short, Hanley is sexy, she’s organised, she has a perfect dry sense of humour and she is noticed by way too few, although we’ve a sneaking suspicion that’s just how she likes it.
Hanna: Mishandle Hanna and karma will come back to get you, although Hanna can look after herself, which means you might get your karma real quick. Hanna is supremely intelligent, so much so she sometimes keeps quiet in an attempt not to embarrass anyone near her, although this is a quality which dissipates as she gets older, thankfully. The artistic streak which runs through her is high-powered and it leads to a glorious, unconventional life. She’s often difficult to pin down and she gathers up strange and wonderful friends everywhere she goes. Hanna.
Hannah:
65% of Hannahs are shy, gentle creatures whose parents insisted she take lessons in either the piano, the cello or the violin. The other 35% are dour competitors with a high tolerance to pain, and who refuse to give in to peer group pressure. 
(As young girls, the 35%-Hannahs placed any instruments given to them on the ground behind the back tyre of their parents’ car, who in turn invariably, and unwittingly, backed over them.)
So, which Hannah are you dealing with?
Hannelie: Hannelie likes the idea of a well-planned, out-of-left-field and potentially confronting holiday. Indeed, she rarely surrounds herself with droll individuals because she likes people who are just like her - inquisitive, interested and dedicated to the more unusual pursuits in life. Would she trek with a group of local tribesman through an African plain, who assure her the lions wont eat her? Damn right she would. And she'd love to see a lion, because she trusts her instincts, and those that she initially places her trust in. Give her waterproof boots over 4-inch stilettos any day.
Hari: Hari is a hugger. And they're good. She's the sort of gal' who walks into the local organic cafe and is known and adored by literally everyone present, be they staff or customers.
Harlow: Yes, she's a sophisticate but don't forget that she loves people and she's extremely generous with her time and her resources. You don't believe me? See that homeless shelter there? Well, she raised the funds from countless fund-raising dinners so it could be built. What have YOU done lately?
Harper: Harper loves the idea of the spotlight until she's in it.
Harriett: Harriett is full of pep and possibly even a decent sized ego, but she’s an odd one. Her carefully nurtured childhood, for example, might have given her one of the sweetest voices ever created. Then again, she might have become the compassionate Head Warden of a womens’ prison. Who knows?
Hattie: Whether she's at the grindstone, behind the controls, in front of the crowd, beneath the car, on the roof, up the tree or inside the manager's office, Hattie is embedded so deeply inside your heart that you can't imagine life without her.
Hayleigh: Life’s experiences aren't worth a cracker if they're lived alone, according to Madame, and to this end Hayleigh tends to form the hub of the group. Nope, she won't lead the charge at the male strippers on a girlie night out, nor would she ever volunteer to drive the crowd home (like Charlie-girl) if she was too drunk to drive, but she'll provide a level-headed rock if one is needed. Indeed, she'd keep herself sober so she could drive home those impulsive friends of hers. That’s the kind of person she is. Regardless of what she desires regarding a career, she wants kids and to be surrounded by a loving family.
Hayley: As a little girl she always wanted a pony but her family could never afford one. Full of good intentions for everyone and everything, she’s a good soul and good company.
Hayley-Brea: Hayley-Brea, don't take this the wrong way, but we suggest you head on over to Tricia. Thank you, and have a nice day. (And yes, we still love you. Management.)
Hayli: Hayli has a bit more grunt than her sisters, although she only got into cake decorating so she could eat them.
Hazel: Hazel is at ease. Hazel is warm. Hazel is wonderful
Heather: It was once hypothesised that if Heather didn’t spend each day in bad weather, she’d do a special rain dance and concoct it herself, sometimes quite unconsciously. Now, this may or may not be true, but some people are encumbered with, not only the defence of the country, but in devising a plan of attack in the war room which, by definition, requires great secrecy and intense concentration, and it’s not to be taken lightly. Do you think Heather derives any pleasure from sending up a squadron of rookie pilots against the imminent onslaught, knowing full-well at least a third of them won’t make it back alive? It rips her heart out. So, do her a favour: Take her to dinner. Take her dancing. Take her on a picnic or a visit to the museum or art gallery. If you are her partner, randomly lift up her jumper and kiss her belly sometimes. You with me? She could use the support, that’s all…
Heaven: I wonder how a person would cope being named Satan Reincarnate? Anyway, Heaven is a chaotic nightmare, although it’s not her fault because her parents were off with the bloody fairies when they named her. She's not angry, or malicious or a nasty person, she's just wasteful, she lacks foresight and she is easily led. Might be time for a name change lass. How about Liz? Just for a few weeks to see how you go…(The one caveat we give with Heaven’s name is the following: if she acquired it after an ayahuasca ceremony, during which she convened with creatures, spirits and animals from other realms and dimensions, then Heaven is someone each of needs to go and spend some time with, and I’d be ignoring all that we said beforehand. Amen.)
Heide: If you give Heide a job in the company, expect her to be running the organization within a year or two. We also suggest that you don't fight the process. She's a great leader and she thinks clearly. What more do you want at the top?
Heidi:
Option A:  A German wrestler who was given her name by her manager because he insisted she do something to soften her image. And it nearly worked.

Option B:  Lives in the hinterland, is completely psychic, and runs a market stall where she sells kiddies clothes and/or South American artefacts.
Helen: Now here is the sort of woman who gets things done but rarely receives the kudos she secretly needs or deserves. As a rather complex soul, Helen doesn’t have time to try and be sexy – either she is or she isn’t – for there’s simply too much weight on her shoulders to worry about such banalities.
Helena: Helena is the name of the sound produced by two large, smooth chunks of limestone being rubbed together. For such a harsh activity the sound produced is surprisingly exotic and calming. “Hey hey…,” the noise will tell you, soothingly. “…..it will be alright.” (Just be careful not to put your fingers in between them.)
Helene: Helene lives for her hot soy decaf latte with a pot of hot water on the side, and when she jogs with the girls she attempts to look as ambivalent as possible, even though she ties a little jumper around her waist to stop people looking at her bum, and whether she has a nice one or not. Strange, eh?
Helga: Helga charges at life like a battering ram in the hands of the Huns. The quickest route between two points is a straight line, she'll tell you. In past life she dug through mountains with her bare hands and these days, if her lover is not performing well in bed, there will be immediate reprocussions.
Helina: Helina is the kind of girl who hates getting all jazzed up for a night on the town with her friends, bitching and complaining bout this and that while she begrudgingly gets ready, but she's always the last one to get in the taxi/Uber for the trip home.
Henrietta: Submarine Commander. She moves with stealth if need be, in a bad mood she's awfully dangerous and once she hits shore for some well-earned R&R you'll barely be able to keep up with her. She's a fair but imposing leader.
Hermione: Oh my goodness, so you do exist, eh? Well let’s take a good look at you, girl. Yes, splendid posture, well spoken, your mummy and daddy have money and for your 18th birthday it looks like you’re going to get that new stallion you’ve been gawking at. Good luck in the country-side!
Hetti:
Hetti is like the game Jemanji. Ever see the movie?
Anyway, you look at the box of the game and you think, "Okay, this looks interesting. This might keep us and kids amused for an hour or so."
And then you open the box and begin to play and your life may never be the same again, but you’re going to have to be prepared to give yourself to the process, fully.
Hetti.
Hien: What a craftswoman. She walks quietly, as if praying in a temple, and the final result is without rival. Simple as that.
Hilary: Hil ary goes about her business with a precision that a Swiss watch-making company would be proud of. She cares little for what anyone says about her, be it good or bad, she knows what she wants and there it is.
Hilda: Yeah I know, you wouldn't picture Hilda as a sexual deviant. We would. Hilda is an untapped volcano spring of anything you want. The fact that she constantly reminds us that she can suck a golf ball through a garden hose tells us something. Go you wonderful thing, Hilda! Love Management.
Hill: Hill is cool. She laughs at herself as well as everyone else. She's sexy in a summer dress, in fact she's pretty sexy no matter what she's wearing, and she's here to help the rest of us try and figure out how the hell we're supposed to open our presents. God knows she's spent enough time preparing everything.
Hilly: Incredibly clumsy and forgetful, Hilly’s moments of greatness and great achievement arrive largely as a complete fluke. And she’s chirpy.
Hirani: If Hirani was any more chilled out she'd pass as a walking zombie. Although you never see zombies smile like Hirani does. Life for this girl is a flowing river of friends and funny moments and laughter, with the odd petty tributary of family drama and tragedy that gets absorbed into the main flow along with everything else.
Hoda: An Islamic form of 'ohmmmm'. Hoda, therefore, is a secret and sexy treasure. But, can you commit?
Holger: Holger is a fascinating creature with blonde hair. As a large Grizzly Bear in a past life, Holger is desperately keen to chill out and relax in this life, yet she inadvertently finds herself needing to put idiots in a headlock from time to time, just to shut them up, or, as is usually the case, to stop them from hurting themselves. Being a female bouncer has its perks though, and she has a laugh that can be heard for miles. Exceptionally bright.
Holiday: With a name like a leading lady in a 1950s Jerry Lewis movie (Google him if you've never heard of him), Holiday, by her very nature, is unable or unwilling to deal with dour or morose situations or people. Light and fluffy as a bag of feathers, Holiday giggles and twirls around, and she's crashed her car several times.
Hollie:
Yeah, she's cute, she's funny, she's slack sometimes, she's pretty good at most things (when she puts her mind to it) and she has a fantastic smile, which belies the most important facet of her entire personality - 
Hollie is perpetually happy and happiness, glory be, is contagious.
Holly: Spurned in school by the girls for being too wonderful, she flourished in her teens when she became a model. When she tired of that she went pro with the cello and the last I heard she was about to take up a post doc at CERN.
Honie: The name of any stunning Pacific Ocean tropical sunrise. That is, she is a vivid orange sun, and she is the warm still air that smells of clean ocean salt.
Honor: Often a name will generate the opposite. Take Angel for instance - she’s a fucking nightmare - but Honor doesn't suffer this fate at all. Like her name, she avoids pointless gossip, she's garrulous only when or if a person or situation requires it and she has the knack of knowing what's around the corner before she gets there. How does she do this? No one knows, but it enables her to float around obstacles. In short, people adore her and rightly so - there's plenty to love - and we're very glad she's here.
Hope: Sensitive, my arse. Hope is and will always be, The Raging Bull.
Hristina: Hristina wouldn't allow her daughter to marry a man she thought was beneath her, no matter how much in love she says she was. (Hristina, lighten-up!)
Humble: Desperately stylish, Humble proves no one is just their name. Extremely self-aware, Humble deals with the shadows of the city like a cat.
Hunter: Hunter spends an average of 45 minutes per day shoe shopping.
Hytal: Imagine Hytal as a pristine waterfall in an untouched rain forest, who knows how to handle small arms. Her eyes are either dark brown or a deep green and her smile, depending on your predilections, will possibly break your heart.
